description: VERA provider chain: lowest-cost capable model per task. Fallback order = cost then capability.

m2_gate_a_scoring.description: Gate A: score candidates 0–1 on relevance, evidentiary value, cost/risk

chain.rationale: Fast, cheap, handles 32k context, sufficient for scoring
Reliable fallback if Groq rate limited
Last resort if both free tiers exhausted

m3_evidence_extraction.description: Extract verbatim spans from source content with offsets

chain.rationale: Fast extraction, 32k window size handles long sources
Most reliable if free tiers fail

m3_appraisal_rubric.description: Score source on 6 GRADE/CASP domains (1–5 scale each)

chain.rationale: Excellent at structured output, cheaper than OpenAI
Cheaper fallback if Mistral rate limited
Most reliable if both free tiers exhausted

m5_synthesis.description: Generate grounded response using reasoning context + evidence citations

chain.rationale: Strong generation quality, better citation handling than Groq
Most reliable for complex synthesis; fallback if Mistral fails

m5_claim_verification.description: Verify each claim traces to supporting evidence (legitimacy laundering check)

chain.rationale: Fast verification, sufficient for binary trace checking

m6_comparative_eval.description: Score engineered vs baseline on 5 dimensions with rationale

chain.rationale: Faster but may lose nuance on complex comparisons
Most consistent if free tiers fail

optimistic_run.assumption: All tasks complete on free tier without rate limiting

realistic_run.assumption: One task hits rate limit, falls back to OpenAI

pessimistic_run.assumption: Free tiers consistently rate limited, all OpenAI
